question: Do companies have to train their staff on AI under the AI Act?
claim: Providers and deployers of AI systems are obligated to support the development of AI literacy among their staff and others involved in operating and using AI systems on their behalf. [1]

question: Does the AI Act apply to AI systems used only for military purposes?

question: According to Article 65, who sits on the European Artificial Intelligence Board?
claim: The European Artificial Intelligence Board is composed of one representative per Member State.
sources_text: [1] Article 65(2) - The Board shall be composed of one representative per Member State. The European Data Protection Supervisor shall participate as observer. The AI Office shall also attend the Board’s meetings, without taking part in the votes. Other national and Union authorities, bodies or experts may be invited to the meetings by the Board on a case by case basis, where the issues discussed are of relevance for them.
